typeBlock.description: This type is used to carry Forward Error Correction related metadata to support the multiple code blocks for the Worldview spacecraft.

tlv.description: The total number of FEC codeblocks per frame. Used to assemble decoded frames containing multiple codeblocks. This is always set to 1 unless using the Worldview frame structure. (Default: 1)

Number of the codeblock represented in the payload for this portion of the complete frame, starting at codeblock #1. Used to assemble decoded frames containing multiple codeblocks. This is always set to 1 unless using the Worldview frame structure. (Default: 1)
